sources.title: Taxi-V4 — LATlag/Taxi-V4 | Essa Mamdani
sources.snippet: Taxi-V4 is a Hugging Face model repository focused on the Taxi-v3 reinforcement-learning environment and q-learning. It may be relevant for developers experimenting with tabular or custom reinforcement-learning implementations, evaluating Taxi-v3 behavior, or studying how a small environment-specific agent is organized.
